title: RBI Draft Directions on Harmonised Interest Rates for Banks and NBFCs
description: <cite index="56-2,56-4,56-5">The RBI issued draft rules on harmonised interest rate determination to align policies between banks and NBFCs. The draft proposes to issue harmonised directions prescribing a principles-based framework for determination of interest rates on fixed and floating rate loans, proposed to come into effect from April 1, 2027.</cite>
